transcript.text: theres water in the bottom of my frige under the salad draws, keeps comming back after i mop it up

From what you have described, the most likely cause is a blocked defrost drain hole. At the bottom of the back wall inside the fridge there's a small drain hole or channel that carries defrost water away. If it blocks, water collects inside. Clear it gently with warm water (a turkey baster or a squeezy bottle works) or a soft pipe cleaner. Was the drain hole blocked (and is it clear now), is it blocked or frozen and you couldn't clear it, or was it already clear?

ok i had a look and there was a little hole at the bottom of the back wall with bits of lettuce and gunk in it. i cleared it with a cotton bud and warm water and the water went straight down. no more puddle for a few days now. the water was only ever inside the fridge, nowhere near the plug btw
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
